title: Reissued Plan Premium, Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
The reissued plan premium on a Real Estate Service Contracts order is worked out from the plan now on the order and the order's property facts.

**Plan list premium.** The plan list premium is the base premium of the plan now on the order, plus the oversize surcharge when the square footage is at or above the oversize threshold, plus the additional dwelling unit premium for each dwelling unit beyond the first, minus the condominium or townhome deduction when the property type is condominium or townhome. Each of these figures is the one the plan now on the order carries in its premium schedule; the square footage, unit count and property type are those on the order.

**Reissued plan premium.** The reissued plan premium is the plan list premium, rounded to the cent.

## The parts in a table

| Part | Taken from | Applies | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base premium | the plan now on the order | always | starting amount |
| Oversize surcharge | the plan now on the order | square footage at or above the oversize threshold | added |
| Additional dwelling unit premium | the plan now on the order | each dwelling unit beyond the first | added per unit |
| Condominium or townhome deduction | the plan now on the order | property type condominium or townhome | deducted |

## Worked examples (hypothetical plan figures: base premium $600.00, oversize surcharge $120.00 at 5000 sq ft, additional dwelling unit premium $400.00, condominium or townhome deduction $60.00)

- Single-family home, 1 unit, 5600 sq ft: $600.00 plus $120.00 gives **$720.00**.
- Townhome, 1 unit, 2000 sq ft: $600.00 less $60.00 gives **$540.00**.
- Multi-unit property, 3 units, 4000 sq ft: $600.00 plus two additional units at $400.00 gives **$1400.00**.
